purpose: Document first-party Aizawl/Mizoram land-record discovery, public route attempts, safe-field limits, and uncertainty.
assessment: Official Mizoram evidence establishes Land Revenue & Settlement Department custody and an e-ram integrated GIS land-record system launched in Aizawl District. No safe anonymous native parcel ID plus complete polygon was obtained.
registryAssessment: registryFound=true is supported by the official e-ram portal and official Mizoram government statement naming Aizawl District deployment. This is local/district service custody evidence only; it is not source integration, ownership evidence, or proof of citywide parcel availability.

officialPrimarySources.observation: Official Land Revenue & Settlement Department portal lists land-related application forms and identifies the department.
Official portal explains the department's survey, settlement, land-record, and revenue functions.
Official state-government address says e-ram is an integrated GIS land-record system developed by Land Revenue & Settlement and launched in Aizawl District on 5 November 2024.
Official DoLR NAKSHA portal describes a national urban land-survey/geospatial programme; it did not provide a verified anonymous Aizawl feature response in this pass.
Official DoLR ULPIN page describes parcel identifiers and geo-referenced cadastral maps nationally; it is programme documentation, not an Aizawl parcel endpoint.
